ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

=========================================================================

私たちのチームは、自動運転技術をさらに進化させるため、最先端のSIL（Software-in-the-Loop）環境の構築と革新に取り組んでいます。現行では、ClosedSILSとOpenSILSという2つの環境を核とし、それぞれの特性を最大限に活かしながら効率的なソフトウェア評価と検証を行っています。この他、開発効率向上に不可欠な処理速度の高速化にも重点を置いています。

ClosedSILSでは、シミュレーターを自動運転ソフトウェアとリアルタイムで接続し、フィードバックループを形成することで、ダイナミクスや車両制御ロジックを動的に評価しています。この環境では、シミュレーションモデルそのものの精度向上に取り組むとともに、生成される信号を実車の動作と正確に紐付けるための技術開発を進めています。また、シミュレーションをより高速に処理するための計算最適化や負荷軽減技術を導入し、開発プロセスのスピードと精度を同時に向上させることを目指しています。

一方で、OpenSILSは、実車で走行した際のログデータを活用し、ソフトウェア挙動をオフライン環境で検証するための基盤を提供します。特に、実車環境で発生する通信遅延やCPU負荷による処理遅延といった事象を忠実に再現することが重要なテーマとなっています。OpenSILSでは、実車で得られるログデータを単に流し込むだけでなく、それを基に負荷状況や処理のタイミングを意識した補正を加えることで、仮想環境でも実車と同じ条件下で事象を再現する技術開発を進めています。このアプローチにより、実車で発生した問題の根本的な原因を効率的に突き止め、ソフトウェア改良を効果的に行うことが可能になります。

ClosedSILSとOpenSILSに共通する課題として、処理速度の高速化が挙げられます。シミュレーションのリアルタイム性能を最大化し、極限まで効率化されたテスト環境を提供することで、ソフトウェア開発のスピードを飛躍的に向上させる特性を両者に組み込んでいます。この一連の取り組みを通じて、自動運転技術が抱える安全性と信頼性の課題を解決し、未来志向の開発基盤を築いています。

私たちの活動は、シミュレーションと実車データ解析を融合させながら、自動運転技術の開発に最適な包括的な環境を提供するものです。技術者として新たな挑戦に取り組みつつ、未来のモビリティ技術に貢献できる環境で成長を遂げることができるでしょう。

私たちのチームは、自動運転技術の進化を共に支える志を持ち、SIL環境の構築や改善に意欲的に取り組める人材を求めています。特に以下のようなスキルや経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します：
  • シミュレーション技術の知識：ClosedSILSおよびOpenSILSを活用したシミュレーション環境やフィードバックループ構築の経験
  • データ解析技術：実車で取得したログデータを活用し、負荷状況や処理遅延の動作を正確にモデリング・再現するスキル
  • リアルタイム処理の最適化：SIL環境内での高速処理を実現するための計算最適化や並列処理技術への理解と実務経験
  • 精度向上への挑戦：シミュレーションモデルに関する深い理解を元に、実車挙動との紐付け精度を向上させる取り組みへの意欲
    • この役割では、ソフトウェアロジックがどのように実車に反映されるかを深く理解しながら、業界が抱える安全性や信頼性の課題解決に貢献していただきます。また、リアルタイム性能や事象解析精度を高めることで、次世代自動運転技術の基盤を共同で作り上げることができます。

    私たちの現場では、コンピュータサイエンス、組込みシステム、制御ロジック設計、シミュレーション技術など、幅広い専門知識を融合して課題解決に挑む環境が整っています。新しい技術的な課題に果敢に立ち向かいたい方、技術者としてのさらなる成長を目指したい方にとって理想的なチームです。

    ","id":"647e0a1c-4e5a-4516-84c5-e82f49d94b81","lists":[{"text":"TEAM","content":"
    The Human System Integration team is developing the human machine interface (HMI), which helps ensure that drivers can use advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) safely and securely. As ADAS replaces part of human cognition, judgment, and operation, we aim to promote mutual understanding between the car and humans through HMI and deliver safe, reliable mobility to more people in more places. HMI development has many driver features and directly contributes to the improvement of the car’s product appeal, thus making a significant contribution to car manufacturing.
    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    You will develop HMI control applications to cover advanced driver assistance systems. Our application depends on information from the vehicle control application and sensors, and also generates interactive notifications on the Meter, HUD and multimedia systems, you will need to establish cooperative relationships with other hardware and software engineers. We are involved in many projects from the planning and conceptualization phase to the development phase, and therefore we are looking for engineers with solid coding skills, extensive knowledge of software development, and logical thinking abilities to derive optimal solutions. The ideal candidates will be able to lead the team, work independently to complete tasks, and communicate smoothly with stakeholders around them. You’ll report to the manager in charge of HMI application development.
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
  • Lead the team in defining requirements, designing functionality including communication specification between electronic control units for the HMI control application, software implementation and validation
  • Conduct HMI evaluations using a vehicle and a driving simulator, and work with team members and related applications teams to quickly respond to specification changes
  • Conduct reviews and provide advice to ensure software quality in mass-production development
  • Negotiate with Toyota Motor Corporation and the other partners to establish development items, schedules, and budget
  • You will come to our office 3 days per week following our hybrid work policy
    • "},{"text":"MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS","content":"
  • 3+ years in software engineering for consumer-focused applications
  • Experience as tech lead, helping other programmers with software implementation projects
  • Experience working directly with a variety of teams both internal and external to understand and share the requirements, specifications and the technical details
  • Ability and experience communicating in Japanese, including written and oral, in a working environment
    • "},{"text":"NICE TO HAVES","content":"
  • 3+ years of experience in HMI development for mass production vehicles or development of control software for cockpit ECUs of Meter, HUD, or multimedia systems
  • 3+ years of production-level programming experience in C
  • Experience in embedded or ECU software development (practical experience in software architecture design, software implementation, verification, and evaluation)
  • Experience in model-based development (MBD) using MATLAB, Simulink, or similar technologies
  • Experience in mobile/web/desktop application development using Python, Flutter, Unity, Blender, or similar
  • Background with automotive industry standards such as functional safety (ISO 26262) and SOTIF
  • Project management experience with Agile/Scrum
  • Driving simulator development experience
  • Experience in UX planning and interactive design

    ","id":"19eba664-5273-4221-831c-e27a8266a4f7","lists":[{"text":"TEAM","content":"

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.

    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    The Info Mobility Car team in the Mobility BU develops driver support features that provide driving suggestions
    and voice prompts to drivers.
    We aim to enable safer and more comfortable driving experiences by leveraging　in-cabin and external camera images and various vehicle sensor data, with driver “busyness” and state estimation algorithms as our core technology.
    Working closely with software development teams and simulation-based evaluation teams, we continuously drive performance improvements of these features.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/ 

    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    We are looking for someone who can lead the development of ML-based algorithms that estimate driver
    workload (busyness) by combining vehicle CAN signals, various in-vehicle sensors, and driver operation logs
    as time-series data. 
    We welcome candidates who can leverage their expertise in driver state estimation, vehicle dynamics, sensor fusion, and machine learning to design and refine robust driver workload indices, while balancing them with other workload indicators such as surrounding-vehicle and vision-based measures.
    We envision someone who is comfortable working in a high-uncertainty domain, iteratively testing hypotheses
    with data, and collaborating with stakeholders to translate technical outcomes into product value.
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
  • Design, implement, and enhance ML-based driver workload (busyness) estimation algorithms that take vehicle CAN signals, various in-vehicle sensors, and driver operation logs as time-series inputs
  • Build and operate training data infrastructure and evaluation pipelines, including label and annotation policy design, data preprocessing, and feature engineering
  • Investigate and improve logics that combine CAN-based workload indicators with other workload measures, such as surrounding-vehicle information and image/vision-based indicators
  • Design interfaces and specifications to feed workload estimation results into driving suggestion and voice prompt logic, and continuously improve overall feature performance
  • Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, UX members, and other stakeholders to align on requirements and evaluation metrics, and to organize and share experiment results and technical learnings
  • Participate, as required by projects and business needs, in planning and conducting evaluations using simulators and on-road test vehicles (including business trips), and drive improvement cycles based on real-world findings

  • Ability to independently drive the end-to-end ML development process from data preprocessing and feature design through training and evaluation
  • Communication skills to work with multiple stakeholders and clearly explain technical topics and evaluation results
  • Willingness to travel for business purposes as required by project or business needs
  • Business level Japanese proficiency and conversational level English

    We are looking for an AI Platform Engineer who will enable teams developing and operating AI products to deliver high-quality AI capabilities faster, more safely, and on a sustainable basis.
    This position is not responsible for developing individual product features. Instead, the mission is to design, implement, and operate the shared platforms, workflows, and guardrails required for AI product development, evaluation, release, and operations. By reducing manual work and reliance on individual knowledge, you will improve development productivity, operational efficiency, and the quality and reliability of AI outputs across the organization.
    From an MLOps perspective, you will build and improve systems that support reliable operations through the management of models, data, experiments, evaluation results, and releases; CI/CD; infrastructure configuration management; monitoring, log collection, and alerting; and automation of incident response. You will also build mechanisms with validation workflows, policies, and evaluation methodologies, including agent-based code review.
    From an LLMOps perspective, you will drive the design and operation of feedback loops that collect and organize user feedback, usage logs, AI quality evaluation results, incidents, and failure cases, and use these insights to improve agents and tools. You will be expected not only to experiment with emerging technologies, but also to turn them into solutions that can be continuously used in real development environments, with due consideration for security, quality, reproducibility, and operational sustainability.
    You will work closely with product development teams, ML engineers, and security and cloud infrastructure stakeholders to evolve a reusable AI Platform that supports multiple products.
    This position reports to a functional leader. The work arrangement is hybrid, and travel to Woven City several times per month is required.

    We are looking for the first dedicated QA Engineer for our AI products—someone who understands and embraces the uncertainty and non-deterministic nature of LLM-based systems, and who is interested not only in testing quality, but in making quality work as a sustainable system.

    In this role, you will go beyond executing individual test cases.     ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

    私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

    =========================================================================

    Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。

    Woven Cityに関する詳細は、以下をご覧ください：
    https://www.woven-city.global/jpn/
    "},{"text":"求める人材","content":"
    AIプロダクトを開発・運用するチームが、より速く、安全かつ継続的に高品質なAI機能を提供できるよう支援する、AI Platform Engineerを募集します。
    本ポジションは、個別のプロダクト機能そのものを開発する役割ではありません。AIプロダクトの開発・評価・リリース・運用に必要な共通基盤、ワークフロー、ガードレールを設計・実装・運用し、手作業や属人的な対応を減らしながら、組織全体の開発生産性、運用効率、AI出力の品質と信頼性を高めることがミッションです。
    MLOpsの観点では、モデル・データ・実験・評価結果・リリースの管理、CI/CD、インフラ構成管理、監視・ログ収集・アラート、障害対応の自動化などを通じて、安定的に運用できる仕組みを整備していただきます。また、Agent code reviewを含む検証フロー、ポリシー、評価方法を備えた仕組みを構築します。
    加えて、LLMOpsの観点では、ユーザフィードバック、利用ログ、AI品質評価の結果、インシデントや失敗事例などを収集・整理し、Agentやツールにつなげるフィードバックループの設計・運用を推進します。新しい技術を試すだけでなく、セキュリティ、品質、再現性、運用可能性を考慮し、実際の開発現場で継続利用できる形へ落とし込むことが期待されます。プロダクト開発チーム、MLエンジニア、セキュリティおよびクラウドインフラの関係者と連携し、複数のプロダクトで再利用可能なAI Platformを進化させていただきます。
    このポジションのレポートラインはファンクションのリーダーとなり、勤務形態はハイブリッドです。また、月数回のウーブンシティへの出張があります。
    "},{"text":"業務内容","content":"
  • MLOps／LLMOps基盤および共通ワークフローの設計、実装、運用
  • モデル、プロンプト、Agent設定、評価データ、実験結果、リリース情報を管理・追跡可能にする仕組みの整備
  • AI品質評価エンジニアおよびプロダクト開発チームと連携した、評価の実行・回帰評価・リリース判定を支えるフィードバックループ構築

    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて

    Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.

    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    As the Robot Platform team, we're expanding the concept of mobility beyond vehicles, building human-centric robots that work alongside people in everyday life. By co-creating an integrated robotic platform with Woven City's Weavers and Inventors, we develop robots people resonate with that grow smarter with every use, freeing people from tedious tasks and expanding human potential. Our ambition is to make Woven City a robot product factory, combining SW/HW platforms, AI, city infrastructure, and mass production.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

The Chief of Staff will build trusted, collaborative relationships with the Product and Technology leadership team and key stakeholders across Woven By Toyota, Toyota, and beyond.  You are passionate about transforming technology to save lives and improve the quality of lives.

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.

    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all. Our team facilitates the safe and smooth implementation of a wide variety of Proof of Concepts (PoCs) conducted in this city by driving continuous process improvement (Kaizen) and robust risk governance. In this role, you will operate the Secretariat for both Woven City Crisis Management and Confidential Management, establishing and improving robust frameworks that protect the city's physical safety and informational assets under a fast-paced development environment, while driving the development of systems, processes, and tools that enable the entire organization to tackle crises effectively, even in the event of company-wide incidents. 

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/ 

    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    1)We are seeking an experienced professional to play a central role in the Crisis Management Secretariat, which protects the safety and security of Woven City as its highest priority. In response to a wide range of city-specific crises—such as natural disasters (typhoons and earthquakes), personal or property accidents, system failures, and data breaches—and guided by the philosophy that "the initial response is the most important," you will be expected to lead initial emergency responses, make rapid crisis-level judgments, escalate issues to relevant departments, and manage the setup and operation of the Emergency Response Team (ERT). Furthermore, you are expected to continuously refine our frameworks and processes during normal times to ensure robust preparedness. We also expect you to continuously refine your systems and processes even during normal times to maintain a robust defense posture.

    2)Additionally, we are seeking a professional to play a central role in the Confidential Management Secretariat, which protects critical informational assets such as advanced technologies and personal data handled by Woven City. We look for an expert who can lead the strict enforcement of our Data Classification Policy (specifically Confidential and Highly Confidential data), design precise access control and permission structures across shared folders (Google Drive/ Share Point, etc.) , and manage regular access auditing operations.

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.
     
    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    Decarb Venture Studio is a venture creation organization within Woven by Toyota. Our mission is to democratize decarbonization: to move decarbonization from the work of a limited number of specialists into an accessible, practical activity that every organization and every person can take part in.

    We combine the ownership, speed, and creativity of a startup with the scale, credibility, and real-world learning opportunities of Toyota. We do not build from assumptions alone. We learn from complex, real operations, identify repeatable patterns, and transform those insights into scalable software products that can create value far beyond Toyota.

    Our first venture has moved from proof of concept into beta development. It is a B2B application that unifies operational infrastructure data such as electricity, gas, fuel, and water. We are building its data foundation using advanced IoT, AI, blockchain, and cloud technologies. We care as deeply about intuitive, consumer-grade user experience as we do about technical sophistication.

    Decarb Venture Studio will not stop at one product. We will commercialize and scale the first service while continuously exploring the next opportunity through customer discovery, proofs of concept, and prototypes.
    We follow a hybrid workstyle, combining office and remote work. Additionally, depending on future circumstances, business trips to Toyota Motor Corporation or the Toyota Group may be required.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

    We are looking for someone who is energized by complex customer environments and can move fluently between field observation, business process design, product thinking, implementation, and customer success.

    You will design the path from first deployment to sustained adoption: customer discovery, success criteria, data and sensor readiness, onboarding, operating workflows, training, support, value measurement, and expansion.

    This is not a conventional account management role. It is a hands-on venture-building role for someone who wants to prove customer value in reality and turn customer-specific learning into a repeatable product and go-to-market model.

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.

    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    The Department Operations Project Manager belongs to the Operation Management Office (OMO). The OMO is part of the Inventor Acceleration & Service (IA&S) Department within Woven City Management. Reporting directly to the Department Head, OMO is a team responsible for establishing and strengthening the operational foundation for the IA&S Department as a whole. IA&S provides comprehensive acceleration and hands-on support to Inventor companies conducting demonstrations and trials in Woven City. This support spans the full lifecycle—from planning and execution of demonstrations to service utilization and issue resolution.

    OMO supports the Department Head’s decision-making and enhances the quality, speed, and repeatability of execution across the Department. It does so through cross-functional management practices, including management rhythm, OKR/KPI management, cross-functional coordination, and governance.

    In addition to operating the organization, OMO plays a critical role in connecting the Voice of Customer (VOC) gathered from Inventors and on-site operations to the Department’s strategy and continuous improvement initiatives. Through these efforts, OMO helps continuously enhance the services delivered in Woven City.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/ 

    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    Department Operations Project Manager reports to the OMO Leader and works closely with them to drive a broad range of initiatives related to department operations and service improvement.

    Rather than simply operating established processes, this role requires gathering the necessary information from across and outside the Department, structuring key issues, engaging relevant stakeholders, and translating insights into decisions and actions.

    We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing clarity to complex, multi-functional environments involving diverse stakeholders—identifying the core issues, determining who needs to make decisions, and defining the next steps needed to move execution forward.

    This role will also contribute to transforming the Voice of Customer (VOC) collected from Inventors and on-site operations into meaningful improvements. Rather than treating VOC as isolated feedback, the Assistant Manager will help structure issues, prioritize opportunities, and connect them to concrete continuous improvement actions.
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
    1. Department Operations / Operation Management Office (OMO)
    　　　・Support decision-making and action execution by planning and operating key Department meetings, OKR/KPI management, and various management processes
    　　　・Identify and organize issues, dependencies, and priorities across multiple functions and stakeholders, driving cross-functional alignment and execution
    　　　・Support the development of an efficient and repeatable operating foundation by establishing and improving Department governance, management tools, processes, and information aggregation practices
    　　　・Contribute to the visibility of key business operating metrics—including budget versus actual performance, revenue, and profitability—through Department budget optimization activities

    2. Continuous Improvement PDCA Based on Voice of Customer
    　　　・Collect and organize Voice of Customer (VOC) input and other relevant evidence from Inventors and associated stakeholders to identify and visualize service and operational issues
    　　　・Analyze and prioritize issues, and perform the management activities needed to translate them into concrete continuous improvement actions, including coordination with existing initiatives and appropriate escalation where required
    　　　・Collaborate with stakeholders to track action progress and develop mechanisms that enable ongoing feedback and continuous improvement

    In addition to the responsibilities above, this role will work closely with the Department Head and OMO Leader and may take on a broad range of responsibilities depending on business needs, including advancing Department strategy, organizational operations, and critical initiatives.

    We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Director, Global Head of Product Delivery to lead our engineering team in the development and integration of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). The ideal candidate will have substantial experience in guiding experts and influencing global stakeholders in the commercialization of automotive technology. A deep understanding of systems engineering, particularly in ADAS technologies, integration, testing, safety, and compliance with industry standards, is important. This role is critical for ensuring our ADAS solutions are seamless. 
    "},{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"
  • ADAS Development and Integration: Lead the engineering team in the development and software and hardware integration of ADAS technologies into development vehicles and test benches, ensuring functionality, safety, and performance. Oversee middleware and release process.
  • System Design and Architecture: Oversee the design and architecture of vehicle systems, ensuring that ADAS components are integrated effectively and efficiently to facilitate a quick learning loop for data-driven development
  • Verification and Validation: Develop and implement comprehensive verification and validation strategies to ensure ADAS systems meet all safety and performance requirements.
  • Safety and Compliance: Ensure all ADAS designs comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements, developing safety cases and managing safety protocols.
  • Performance Metrics: Establish and monitor performance metrics to measure ADAS system performance, reliability, and maturity.
  • Vehicle Testing: Oversee vehicle test operations, including planning, execution, and analysis of test results to validate ADAS performance in real-world conditions.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with design, engineering, and product teams to ensure ADAS integration and system performance goals are met.
  • Innovation and Improvement: Identify and evaluate opportunities for expanding ADAS capabilities and functionalities, driving continuous improvement in system performance.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and quality of ADAS solutions.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.

    Woven by Toyota is seeking a strategic, globally minded Director, Global Total Rewards — an experienced people leader and hands-on practitioner responsible for leading the design, governance, and delivery of compensation, benefits, payroll, equity, and global mobility programs across the organization.

    This role will develop a competitive, equitable, compliant, and scalable Total Rewards strategy that supports Woven by Toyota's ability to attract, retain, motivate, and develop talent globally. The Director will partner closely with executive leadership, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, HR Operations, and regional HR teams.

    The ideal candidate brings a balance of strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and operational execution, with comfort using modern HR technology to drive Total Rewards programs in a dynamic, data-driven environment. Regular collaboration across global time zones is required.

    "},{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"
    Global Total Rewards Strategy
    • Develop and implement Woven by Toyota's global Total Rewards philosophy and strategy
    • Align rewards programs with business priorities, talent strategy, company values, and financial objectives
    • Establish global principles while adapting programs to local market practices and regulatory requirements
    • Advise senior leadership on compensation, benefits, retention, and rewards-related risks
    • Build strong partnerships with Toyota related entities and external rewards providers
      •  
      Compensation & Job Architecture
      • Lead global compensation structures, salary ranges, incentive programs, and retention programs
      • Oversee job architecture, job-code governance, career-track alignment, and market benchmarking
      • Strengthen internal equity, pay transparency, and pay-for-performance practices
      • Lead annual compensation planning and work with the Global Head of HR and HRBPs on annual performance review, promotion, calibration, and bonus processes
      • Guide complex offers, counteroffers, retention awards, and compensation exceptions
      • Ensure compensation decisions are data-driven, competitive, compliant, and aligned with the company's financial objectives
      • Partner with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations Partners, and Legal on compliance-related programs such as leave of absence and severance
        •  
        Benefits, Payroll & Mobility
        • Establish the global strategy and governance model for employee benefits and wellbeing programs
        • Oversee benefits design, vendor management, enrollment, communications, program evaluation, and compliance audits
        • Provide strategic oversight of global payroll governance and payroll-related controls
        • Partner with Finance, Legal, HR Operations, and vendors on tax, social security, deductions, and compliance
        • Establish principles for international assignments, relocation, expatriate programs, and global mobility
          •  
          Governance & Operations
          • Establish clear approval matrices, decision rights, documentation standards, and escalation procedures
          • Strengthen audit readiness, data privacy, internal controls, and regulatory compliance
          • Partner with HRIS and HR Operations to improve data quality, systems, reporting, and process efficiency
          • Build scalable Total Rewards processes that support a growing global organization
          • Improve employee and manager understanding of Total Rewards programs through clear communication
            •  
            Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
            • Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to ensure alignment and execution of Total Rewards programs
            • Develop and execute communication strategies to help employees understand and value Total Rewards offerings
            • Build manager capability in understanding and applying compensation and benefits programs
              •  
              Leadership
              • Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed Total Rewards team; clarify accountabilities across Compensation, Benefits, Payroll, Mobility, and regional HR teams
              • Operate with sound judgment, governance discipline, and risk awareness
              • Translate data and emerging capabilities into practical, business-relevant applications
              • Build trust and collaboration across HR and business stakeholders, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution
              • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and service-oriented team culture
              • Influence leaders across regions and functions without relying solely on formal authority
              • Apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies thoughtfully and responsibly to improve Total Rewards efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and employee experience — streamlining processes, enhancing analytics, reducing administrative effort, and freeing the team for higher-value strategic work

    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
    ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

    私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

    当社のCorporate Real Estate and Workplace Services（CREWS）部門は、ビジネスの全体目標を促進する、柔軟かつエビデンスに基づいた職場環境の創出に注力しています。私たちは、組織とメンバーが卓越した成果を上げられるよう、盤石な基盤を構築することに専心しています。ハイブリッドな就業形態を最大限に活用するため、CREWSは戦略的パートナーとして、専門的な不動産・管理ソリューションを提供し、物理的なオフィス環境と実業務のニーズを最適に融合させています。
    "},{"text":"求める人材","content":"
    私たちは、日本国内の全拠点において環境・健康・安全（EHS）のイニシアチブを牽引する、先見性と行動力に溢れたEHSマネージャーを求めています。現場の権威として、経営陣を導き、複雑なステークホルダー間のダイナミクスを調整しながら、グローバルな安全基準を実用的かつ各拠点に適した戦略へと昇華させる実行力が求められます。安全かつ環境に配慮した、柔軟な職場環境の構築に専念し、急速に進化する組織内に安全第一の文化を浸透させることに高い意欲を持つリーダーを募集しています。
    "},{"text":"業務内容","content":"

  • 危機およびインシデント管理：
  • 危機管理計画（CMP）の継続的な高度化を牽引し、高い実効性と規制への準拠を維持する

    Software development in the automotive industry comes with unique challenges. Developers need to build, test, secure, and deploy software across cloud environments, mobile devices, embedded systems, and vehicles. They also need modern AI-enabled tools that are safe, governed, observable, and integrated with enterprise systems.
     
    The Developer Productivity function builds tools, platforms, and workflows that help engineering teams at Woven by Toyota and the broader Toyota organization move faster while keeping safety, security, and quality as top priorities.
     
    As part of this function, the Generative AI Engineering team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and developer-facing AI capabilities. We focus on secure access to large language models, AI gateways, internal AI tooling, model usage governance, identity-aware authorization, cost controls, observability, and integrations with engineering systems.
     
    Our goal is to make AI useful, reliable, and safe at enterprise scale.
    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"

    We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-impact Generative AI Engineering team and deliver enterprise-grade AI platform capabilities for Developer Productivity. This role requires experience leading complex engineering projects, partnering closely with engineers and stakeholders, and identifying practical accelerators that improve how engineering teams build, test, operate, and deliver software.

    The ideal candidate is deeply focused on customer value and eager to understand the real problems engineers are trying to solve. They will help the team clarify requirements, make sound technical decisions, align on software design, and deliver reliable platform capabilities that can be adopted across teams.

    Success in this role requires the ability to set direction while remaining close to implementation details. The Engineering Manager will define goals, prioritize work, reduce unnecessary rework, and ensure the team’s roadmap aligns with the broader Developer Experience and Generative AI strategy. They will use metrics to assess adoption, usage, quality, reliability, and business value, continuously improving the team’s impact over time.

    A strong understanding of current trends in developer productivity, platform engineering, and enterprise Generative AI is essential, along with the ability to translate that understanding into a clear and motivating vision for the team.

    This position reports to the Head of Developer Experience and Generative AI. The Engineering Manager will work closely with them to shape strategy, guide execution, and help the team deliver safe, reliable, and useful AI capabilities at enterprise scale. 

    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
  • Define and lead the technical direction for enterprise Generative AI platform capabilities within Developer Productivity
  • Manage and guide the Generative AI Engineering team, working closely with the Head of Developer Experience and Generative AI, engineers, product partners, security teams, identity teams, and internal stakeholders
  • Break down ambiguous, high-level problems into clear technical plans, milestones, and deliverables that the team can execute
  • Own delivery of team commitments, including prioritization, planning, dependency management, progress tracking, and communication of risks or trade-offs
  • Lead the team in building secure, reliable, observable, and maintainable AI platform services, including integrations with AI gateways, LLM providers, identity systems, developer tools, and enterprise systems
  • Define and track metrics for adoption, usage, quality, reliability, cost, and business value of the team’s capabilities
  • Support organizational health through goal setting, regular feedback, progress monitoring, coaching, and growth of team members
  • Manage technical debt and architectural consistency to support long-term maintainability and sustainable delivery
  • Stay close to the team’s technical work by contributing to design discussions, reviewing technical proposals, and occasionally contributing directly to implementation when appropriate
  • Identify and address technical challenges, delivery risks, operational issues, and cross-team blockers
  • Improve engineering excellence across the team by encouraging strong practices for automated testing, CI/CD, code review, observability, documentation, security, and maintainable software design

    Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

    Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

    About the Team

    Enterprise AI is a platform that provides end-to-end machine learning tooling experience to support and accelerate machine learning development, including autonomous driving and other related projects. Our platform serves customers as a standardized machine learning platform within Woven by Toyota as the larger Toyota Group companies.

    The Enterprise AI ML Training Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure that enables engineers and researchers to train, evaluate, and iterate on machine learning models at scale. Our customers include teams working on AD/ADAS and Woven City, where large-scale machine learning workloads, simulation, and data processing are critical to developing the next generation of mobility technologies.

    The team operates at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms. Our systems include large-scale GPU compute environments, Kubernetes-based cluster infrastructure, and workflow and pipeline orchestration technologies such as Ray, Airflow, and Temporal.

    We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team to help shape the technical direction, engineering culture, and long-term evolution of our ML training infrastructure platform.

     

    WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

    As the Engineering Manager, ML Training Infrastructure, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that powers machine learning training workloads across Woven by Toyota.

    You will combine engineering leadership with strong technical judgment. You will work closely with engineering, research, and product stakeholders to understand customer needs, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and ensure that our platform is reliable, efficient, secure, and easy to use.

    This role is particularly suited to an engineering leader who enjoys working on complex infrastructure problems and is comfortable operating across Kubernetes, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, cloud platforms, and machine learning workloads.

    You will also play an important role in building a strong engineering culture, developing engineers, establishing effective engineering practices, and partnering with our customers to continuously improve the platform.

     

    What You Will Enable

    In this role, you will help build the infrastructure that enables teams across Woven by Toyota to train and operate increasingly large and sophisticated machine learning workloads.

    Your work will directly support engineers and researchers working on AD/ADAS, Woven City, and other mobility initiatives by making compute resources easier to access, workloads more reliable, and ML development faster and more scalable.

    You will have the opportunity to shape both the technical architecture of a critical ML infrastructure platform and the engineering culture of the team building it.

  • Construct and maintain Kubernetes-driven compute clusters and container ecosystems tailored for machine learning workloads.

  • Oversee and optimize GPU fleets, addressing cluster scheduling, resource utilization, system stability, and cost performance.

  • Advance distributed model training capabilities and workload management leveraging frameworks like Ray and adjacent tools.

  • Enhance workflow orchestration platforms by deploying and supporting solutions such as Airflow, Temporal, and similar pipeline frameworks.

  • Elevate the system resilience, monitoring insights, elasticity, and operational productivity of our ML training stack.

  • Work closely alongside AD/ADAS, Woven City, and internal platform partners to gather feature requests and ship infrastructure solutions that accelerate development.

  • Partner with cross-functional engineering groups to specify platform interfaces, APIs, system architectures, and operational standards.

  • Translate high-level organizational objectives and user requirements into concrete, executable engineering milestones with product leads.

  • Institute rigorous software practices across implementation, code reviews, automated testing, continuous deployment, and live site management.

  • Engage in production support workflows, lead post-incident reviews, and champion system refinements based on operational findings.

  • Balance immediate client feature requests against long-term architectural stability, technical hygiene, and system maintainability.

  • Foster an inclusive, highly collaborative, and excellence-driven engineering culture throughout Woven by Toyota.

    About the Team

    Enterprise AI is a platform that provides end-to-end machine learning tooling experience to support and accelerate machine learning development, including autonomous driving and other related projects. Our platform serves customers as a standardized machine learning platform within Woven by Toyota as the larger Toyota Group companies.

    The Enterprise AI ML Training Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure that enables engineers and researchers to train, evaluate, and iterate on machine learning models at scale. Our customers include teams working on AD/ADAS and Woven City, where large-scale machine learning workloads, simulation, and data processing are critical to developing the next generation of mobility technologies.

    The team operates at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms. Our systems include large-scale GPU compute environments, Kubernetes-based cluster infrastructure, and workflow and pipeline orchestration technologies such as Ray, Airflow, and Temporal.

    We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team to help shape the technical direction, engineering culture, and long-term evolution of our ML training infrastructure platform.

     

    WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

    As the Engineering Manager, ML Training Infrastructure, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that powers machine learning training workloads across Woven by Toyota.

    You will combine engineering leadership with strong technical judgment. You will work closely with engineering, research, and product stakeholders to understand customer needs, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and ensure that our platform is reliable, efficient, secure, and easy to use.

    This role is particularly suited to an engineering leader who enjoys working on complex infrastructure problems and is comfortable operating across Kubernetes, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, cloud platforms, and machine learning workloads.

    You will also play an important role in building a strong engineering culture, developing engineers, establishing effective engineering practices, and partnering with our customers to continuously improve the platform.

     

    What You Will Enable

    In this role, you will help build the infrastructure that enables teams across Woven by Toyota to train and operate increasingly large and sophisticated machine learning workloads.

    Your work will directly support engineers and researchers working on AD/ADAS, Woven City, and other mobility initiatives by making compute resources easier to access, workloads more reliable, and ML development faster and more scalable.

    You will have the opportunity to shape both the technical architecture of a critical ML infrastructure platform and the engineering culture of the team building it.

    About Woven by Toyota
    Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

    Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

    =========================================================================
    ","id":"e86b52ac-4692-4aad-a51d-85abd8848b29","lists":[{"text":"TEAM","content":"

    Toyota is redefining mobility. We continue to challenge conventional ideas of mobility by enabling the movement of people, goods, information, and energy. Woven City serves as a test course where a wide range of mobility solutions can be created and tested, with the vision of building a human-centered city, a city of experimentation, and an ever-evolving city — all in pursuit of “Mobility for All” and the mass production of happiness.

    We aim to contribute to people’s well-being by expanding the possibilities of mobility. In an era where shortages of drivers, energy, and other critical resources are expected to become increasingly significant, we believe mobility can play an even greater role by becoming more advanced, versatile, and efficient.

    The Mobility City Development team develops a mobility ecosystem in which not only advanced products demonstrated in Woven City — such as autonomous driving, eVTOL, and micromobility — but also Toyota’s broader range of mobility solutions are connected and complement one another to create value for society. We also develop the platforms that enable this ecosystem. Our mission is to deploy these platforms in real-world environments and grow them into sustainable and scalable businesses.

    Working not only with mobility operators but also with municipalities and Toyota Group partners, we combine software, mobility, and urban development to create new services that improve both how people move and the value of cities.

    We are currently developing a product that integrates a MaaS system supporting the delivery and operation of mobility services with an end-user application. Looking ahead, we plan to expand the product’s capabilities through integration with other services, systems, and urban infrastructure. This role is not simply about building a digital product — it is about using that product to transform real-world mobility experiences in cities.

    We place strong emphasis on Genchi Genbutsu — going to the source and learning directly from the real environment. We work closely with users and operators in the communities where our services are deployed, and translate those insights into products that create measurable value in collaboration with our Business, Design, and Engineering teams.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"

    We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who can independently drive the design, implementation, testing, and continuous improvement of the frontend for a MaaS product currently in the development and validation stage. You will create intuitive, accessible experiences by understanding the needs, workflows, and environments of both mobility service users and those who provide and operate the services.

    You should have development experience with technologies such as React and TypeScript, with the ability to design and implement reusable UI components, integrate APIs, and manage UI state. We value the ability to choose appropriate implementation approaches that balance rapid development during validation with maintainability, future feature expansion, and integration with other services.

    Working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers, and Business teams, you will translate ambiguous requirements and operational challenges into concrete interfaces, interactions, and functionality. We expect you to propose improvements while communicating technical feasibility and constraints, and to enhance usability, accessibility, rendering performance, and error handling through testing and code reviews.

    We are looking for someone who embraces Genchi Genbutsu—going to the source and learning directly from actual service use and operations—and translates user feedback and usage data into continuous improvement. We value people who bring frontend expertise while taking an interest in adjacent areas, respect their teammates, and proactively solve problems. We also expect you to use emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve development speed and quality while taking responsibility for verifying the quality of your work.

    Woven by Toyota is building a new mobility society that integrates Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs), mobility services, and smart cities.
    To realize this vision, it is essential to ensure Safety, Security, and Quality across all products and services holistically and in an integrated manner.
    The Safety & Quality Line of Business (LoB) leads the establishment and continuous improvement of governance frameworks for safety, security, and quality across Woven by Toyota’s businesses and technology development activities.     The Business Operations Head serves as the strategic arm of the Head of Safety & Quality, driving organizational strategy, governance, operational excellence, and transformation initiatives across the LoB.

We strive to leverage the strengths of both perspectives to build a world-class culture that supports innovation without compromising trust.
    As a strategic partner to the Head of Safety & Quality, this role connects executives and practitioners, global and Japanese stakeholders, and strategy and execution to accelerate the growth and transformation of the Safety & Quality organization.

  • HRBP and Generalist Support: Partner closely with the HR Business Partner team to support the HR needs of assigned business groups and help execute people strategies aligned with business priorities.

  • Manager Support and Coaching: Serve as a responsive resource for managers on day-to-day HR questions, including performance feedback, employee development, policy application, team dynamics, employee engagement, and other people-management practices.

  • Employee Relations: Support and independently manage routine to moderately complex employee relations matters, including intake, fact-finding, documentation, and follow-up. Escalate sensitive, high-risk, or complex issues to the Director, HR Business Partner, Employee Relations, Legal, or other appropriate partners.

  • Performance Management: Support the planning, administration, and communication of performance-management processes. Help managers prepare for performance conversations, document feedback, and navigate performance improvement processes in partnership with the Director, HR Business Partner.

  • Employee Lifecycle Support: Support key employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, new-hire check-ins, internal mobility, employee development, leaves and accommodations coordination as applicable, employee exits, and exit interviews.

  • Employee Engagement: Support employee listening efforts, including engagement surveys, new-hire check-ins, focus groups, and other feedback channels. Identify themes and partner with the Director and business leaders on practical actions that improve employee experience and engagement.

  • Talent and Development Initiatives: Assist with talent planning, succession planning, development planning, and learning initiatives. Help identify employee and manager development needs and coordinate resources or programs with relevant HR partners.

  • Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate employee and organizational data in HRIS systems (Success Factors). Prepare reports, analyze people metrics, identify trends, and provide organized information to support business and HR decisions.

  • HR Projects and Process Improvement: Independently manage assigned HR projects and operational initiatives. Streamline routine processes, maintain clear documentation, track project status, and communicate responsibilities and next steps to stakeholders.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work effectively with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Operations, Learning and Development, Legal, Corporate Finance, Internal Communications and other internal partners to coordinate HR initiatives and provide a consistent employee experience.

  • Coaching and Knowledge Sharing: Share HR knowledge, tools, and practical guidance with colleagues. Support the development of less-experienced team members through mentorship, feedback, documentation, and training as appropriate.

  • Compliance and Policy Application: Apply company policies and working knowledge of California, federal, and applicable local employment requirements in day-to-day work. Identify potential risks and raise concerns promptly to the Director, HR Business Partner or appropriate subject-matter experts.

    Dynamics and Control is a team that aims to develop safer and more secure vehicle maneuver applications for mass production vehicles. In advanced driving assistance systems such as autonomous driving, the ego-velocity and path planning technology is highly required so that the driving trajectory on public roads should be calculated efficiently and smoothly. Our driving planning engineers have been developing optimized velocity and path planning algorithms so as to emulate a skilled driver based on the surrounding environment and obstacles information acquired from the autonomous sensors and lane information from a high-precision map.
    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    An expert in developing the optimized ego-velocity, driving planning and decision-making technology for the autonomous driving system or advanced driving assistance system. The specific areas are as follows.
     
    Longitudinal and lateral vehicle dynamics control such as acceleration, de-acceleration and velocity
    Velocity management based on the acquired data by autonomous sensors and lane information from a high-precision map.
     
    Virtual development and validation with closed-simulation models.
    Optimal velocity and driving planning algorithms subject to environmental, perceptual capabilities, high-precision map and actuation constraints.
     
    Cross-functional discussions about vehicle controller and actuator performance, and contribute to motion control design reviews
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
  • Developing driving planning algorithms to control vehicles in complex and sensitive surrounding environments

    Arene’s mission is to help Toyota improve vehicles every day by creating the platforms and technology for software-defined vehicles. Arene provides a software platform that enables Toyota and its partners to develop, deploy, and continuously improve in-vehicle software more quickly, safely, and flexibly.
    You will join the Arene Product Management team in Nihonbashi, Tokyo, working closely with engineering, design, commercialization, and partner teams across both Arene and Toyota Motor Corporation.
    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    We are looking for a product manager who can turn a complex technical platform into clear product bets that create measurable value for customers, users, and the business. You are comfortable operating in an evolving organization, connecting customer and market insight to a focused roadmap, and working side-by-side with technical leaders to ship and iterate on real products.
    You combine strong product fundamentals (problem framing, discovery, definition, prioritization) with the ability to work in a deeply technical, safety-critical automotive context. You communicate clearly with both executives and engineers, and you can create the documents, meetings, and rituals that keep cross-functional teams aligned without owning every detail yourself.
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
    As Product Manager for Arene, you will be accountable for six core areas across the product lifecycle, plus cross-functional alignment.
     
    Discovery – Customer, User, Market, and Competitive Insight
  • Maintain a current, evidence-based understanding of customer needs, user needs, and market dynamics for your product area
  • Synthesize input from UX research, commercialization, partnerships, and field teams into clear problem definitions and opportunity areas
  • Partner with technical benchmarking, competitive intelligence, and data teams to understand Arene’s position in the market and opportunities to differentiate
    •  
    Definition – What to Build and Why
  • Own the content of the roadmap, Features, and Epics for your product area: problem statement, use cases, acceptance criteria, business value, and success metrics
  • Partner with the Product Planner, who owns the roadmap and release processes, to bring clear, prioritized, and well-framed proposals into intake and planning
  • Collaborate with the technical lead, systems/architecture, UX, and project management to ensure definitions are feasible and appropriately scoped
  • Make thoughtful trade-offs, documenting what is not included and why when scope must flex
    •  
    Delivery – From Plan to Working Software
  • Before build begins, commit to a feasible scope in collaboration with engineering, Product Owner, and project management
  • Once development starts, resolve product decisions quickly so teams are not blocked and delivery risk is visible and managed
  • Support the Project Manager and Product Owner with clear intent, timely decisions, and scope adjustments when constraints emerge; you do not manage the project plan yourself
    •  
    Release – Getting to Customers and Users
  • Make the go/no-go recommendation for features in your product area, ensuring they meet agreed acceptance criteria and are ready for customers
  • Work within the Arene Release Process with the Release Manager; ensure customer- and user-facing teams (Engagement, Solutions, Design, Technical Writing) have what they need for a successful launch
    •  
    Post-Release Iteration – Learning and Deciding What’s Next
  • Track success metrics you defined during Definition and partner with Arene Data and field teams to interpret results
  • Gather structured feedback from customers and users, directly or via services teams, and decide whether to iterate, scale, or sunset features in your product area
    •  
    Cross-Phase – Cross-Functional Alignment and Communication
  • Identify the right cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, UX, commercialization, partnerships, quality, safety, etc.) and provide the space where alignment happens (documents, reviews, recurring meetings)
  • Operate using a PUSH, not PULL principle: you create clear forums and expectations; teams are expected to bring updates and concerns proactively
  • Maintain high-quality internal documentation so that decisions, trade-offs, and context are discoverable and durable
    • "},{"text":"MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS","content":"
    Experience with the practices below is strongly valued; we do not expect perfection in all areas on day one and support growth within the team.
     
  • 10+ years of experience in product management or closely related roles (e.g., platform PM, technical program management, solutions/product owner) in software or complex technical products
  • Experience working with platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products, ideally in automotive, mobility, or other safety-critical domains
  • Demonstrated ability to define and ship products end-to-end: discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and post-release iteration
  • Strong skills in product definition and roadmapping – turning ambiguous inputs into clear problem statements, use cases, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Experience collaborating with engineering leaders on technical feasibility, trade-offs, and incremental delivery plans

  • Business-level English (written and spoken)

    Toyota is redefining mobility. We continue to challenge conventional ideas of mobility by enabling the movement of people, goods, information, and energy. Woven City serves as a test course where a wide range of mobility solutions can be created and tested, with the vision of building a human-centered city, a city of experimentation, and an ever-evolving city — all in pursuit of “Mobility for All” and the mass production of happiness.

    We aim to contribute to people’s well-being by expanding the possibilities of mobility. In an era where shortages of drivers, energy, and other critical resources are expected to become increasingly significant, we believe mobility can play an even greater role by becoming more advanced, versatile, and efficient.

    The Mobility City Development team develops a mobility ecosystem in which not only advanced products demonstrated in Woven City — such as autonomous driving, eVTOL, and micromobility — but also Toyota’s broader range of mobility solutions are connected and complement one another to create value for society. We also develop the platforms that enable this ecosystem. Our mission is to deploy these platforms in real-world environments and grow them into sustainable and scalable businesses.

    Working not only with mobility operators but also with municipalities and Toyota Group partners, we combine software, mobility, and urban development to create new services that improve both how people move and the value of cities.

    We are currently developing a product that integrates a MaaS system supporting the delivery and operation of mobility services with an end-user application. Looking ahead, we plan to expand the product’s capabilities through integration with other services, systems, and urban infrastructure. This role is not simply about building a digital product — it is about using that product to transform real-world mobility experiences in cities.

    We place strong emphasis on Genchi Genbutsu — going to the source and learning directly from the real environment. We work closely with users and operators in the communities where our services are deployed, and translate those insights into products that create measurable value in collaboration with our Business, Design, and Engineering teams.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

    We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can independently lead a MaaS product that is currently in the development and validation stage, from product strategy through execution.

You will structure ambiguous business and user problems, define the problems the product should solve, and translate them into a roadmap, priorities, requirements, and ultimately a tangible product.

    As a Product Manager, you will be accountable for user value and product decisions, working closely with the leads across Business, Engineering, and Design to bring the service to life. We also expect you to actively leverage emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve the speed and quality of product management activities such as research, hypothesis development, requirements definition, and prototyping.

    Our missions: 
    　1. Develop services and products for Woven City

    Toyota Motor Corporation has been involved in a variety of technological development such as artificial intelligence, robotics, and energy technologies, as well as automobile technologies. Toyota is already particularly strong in hardware and we will create additional value by developing new software on top of it.

     As a first party developer, we will not only develop innovative services essential to the city, but also a foundation upon which third party partners can participate. Not only are we developing applications but also more core basic software and capabilities.

     Our team consists of many mid-career members and members with international work experience. We strive to be open minded as we cultivate a new culture. We work closely with Toyota Motor Corporation, Toyota Research Institute in North America and Toyota Motor Europe to develop technologies and products. Our team consists of many members who originate from outside Japan. We provide a global work environment.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

    We are seeking highly self-motivated research engineers with expertise in computer vision and broad engineering skills across both software and hardware to join our Tokyo-based team in building next-generation AI technologies for spatial intelligence. We are working toward AI systems that can perceive and understand the physical world, build rich digital representations of people, objects, and environments, and use this understanding for reasoning, decision-making, and real-world interaction.     Toyota Woven City’s Residents will play an important role by weaving a better future, “the future fabric of life”, through mobility with the inventors. They are the heart of TWC. Through experiencing advanced products and communicating with the inventors, TWC residents are important to inspire the inventors and help them accelerate the development speed of their inventions. We value these activities as our commitment to create “Well-being for all”. We are looking for a person who is ready to take on this important role, creating the inspirations for the residents to take part in the PoC activities, and designing the community for them to participate in the co-creation process.

    To achieve the fine balance of ‘triple-win’ between TWC, Inventors and Residents, we would like you to have the ownership to make negotiations / establish the necessary relationship with multiple stakeholders.

    Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.

    We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.

    Our team, Digital Twin Platform, as one of the core Social Infrastructure/Common Platform teams under the Woven City umbrella, is responsible for the realization of Woven City's vision: "Expand mobility. Enhance humanity. Engage society" by developing a robust software platform, on one hand to enable inventors and business owners to “test” their products in a virtual environment before deploying to the physical Woven City; on the other hand, to create analytics to assist in decision making based on both simulated results and more importantly operational data collected from the physical city, such as residents daily life, traffic dynamics, energy consumption, etc.
    As the Digital Twin Platform is still in its early growth phase, you'll have the rare chance to influence not just what we build but how we bring it to market and experiment with different business models as the platform and its commercial strategy mature together.

    For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/

    The Behavior team at Woven by Toyota builds the data foundation for data-driven autonomy. Our work spans a variety of challenges — analyzing petabytes of multimodal fleet and simulation data, designing scalable data pipelines from ingestion to visualization, and delivering the canonical datasets, metrics, and self-serve tools that power ML-based motion planning across both onboard and offboard systems. We are looking for doers and creative problem solvers to join us in improving mobility for everyone with human-centered automated driving solutions.
    "},{"text":"WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?","content":"
    The team is looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to work in close collaboration with our ML and platform teams to source, transform, and serve high-quality datasets — building data pipelines from ingestion to visualization, and providing the tools and introspection that let others build on our data with confidence. You will have the chance to design and own the data architecture behind multiple large-scale projects, unify data products into a single, trusted foundation, and help accelerate the release of models for our next-generation autonomous vehicle platform, influencing millions of Toyota customer vehicles. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about self-driving car technology and its potential impact on humanity.
    As a senior member of the team, you will act as a technical leader — mentoring engineers, setting the bar for data engineering craft, and raising the data capability of the teams around you. We highly value a "Giver" mindset — consistently asking "What can I do for you?" — combined with the conviction to advocate for the right long-term design even when it is a harder conversation.
    This is a role with significant scope and autonomy. You will set a technical direction that outlasts any single project, thrive on ambiguous, blank-slate problems where the right structure has yet to be defined, and grow your sphere of influence and technical leadership as our data platform matures. It is well suited to an exceptional senior engineer ready to operate at a broader, organization-wide altitude.
    You appreciate a hybrid workspace and can come to our Nihonbashi (Tokyo) office three days per week.
    "},{"text":"RESPONSIBILITIES","content":"
  • Own and set the technical direction for the end-to-end data architecture that unifies our data into a coherent, discoverable, and reliable platform — evaluating design and operational trade-offs across scalability, reliability, and cost with a long-term view rather than optimizing locally
  • Design and build data pipelines from ingestion through transformation to serving and visualization — sourcing, modeling, and delivering the canonical datasets that turn raw fleet and simulation logs into trusted, reusable data, and keeping them consistent across teams
  • Set shared technical direction across teams: partner with stakeholders org-wide to understand their data needs, weigh technical trade-offs rigorously and objectively, influence roadmaps, and drive consensus toward a single, trusted data foundation — representing key insights clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Define and own data products, Service Level Agreements, and the self-serve dashboards and tooling that scale analytics across the organization, along with the monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that keep those promises
  • De-risk major architectural bets before the organization commits to them, using rapid prototypes and focused technical investigations to turn open questions into evidence-based decisions
  • Document architecture, data models, interfaces, and decisions clearly, so that designs, trade-offs, and the resulting datasets are easy for others across the organization to understand, adopt, and maintain
  • Act as a technical leader beyond the team: mentor engineers, establish data engineering best practices and standards that other teams adopt, and raise the data capability of the wider Autonomy organization
    • "},{"text":"MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS","content":"
  • 7+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data platforms at scale
  • Deep command of SQL and a modern programming language (e.g. Python), and hands-on expertise designing robust data models and multi-step ETL/ELT jobs
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and with orchestration and transformation tooling (e.g. dbt, Airflow, or equivalents)
  • Demonstrated ownership of the data architecture for large-scale systems — setting technical direction and reasoning explicitly about scalability, reliability, security, and cost trade-offs
  • A track record of technical leadership across teams — setting engineering standards that others adopt, aligning peers who have competing priorities or differing technical choices, and driving org-wide decisions to closure without formal authority, while growing the capability of other engineers
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity — taking a loosely-defined, cross-team problem and creating the clarity, structure, and momentum to solve it
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly and persuasively
    • "},{"text":"NICE TO HAVES","content":"
  • Experience unifying or consolidating data across multiple pipelines, formats, or storage systems onto a common platform, or migrating from bespoke dataset formats to an open table format (e.g. Apache Iceberg) as the basis of a lakehouse architecture
  • Experience establishing data products, contracts, and SLAs for widely-used datasets, along with data-quality frameworks and observability
  • Experience with large-scale, multimodal data — including spatial and temporal/sequential data (e.g. sensor, log, simulation, time-series, trajectory, or scene/snapshot representations) — and modeling it for reliable downstream use
  • Familiarity with autonomous driving or robotics domain concepts (e.g. vehicle motion — kinematics and dynamics, trajectories, coordinate frames; motion planning and prediction; perception; mapping and localization) and how they shape the data we work with
